card.name: Just before the word surface
card.fires_on: Words right before a likely 'surface' in descriptions of planets, the Sun, skin or objects. It fires on small linking words like 'are', 'can', 'the', 'by', or on 's, where 'surface' is the expected next word.

modes.label: Planets and Sun
modes.description: Linking word or 's in astronomy text where 'surface' or a surface feature comes next.
modes.example: darker, cooler plasma slid and shifted back and forth above the Sun<<’s>> surface seen here for 30 hours

modes.label: Visible features on a body
modes.description: Verbs or commas in descriptions of what is seen on or along an outer layer.
modes.example: Visible on Earth<< are>> vast blue oceans, swirling white clouds,

modes.label: Outside area of things
modes.description: Words in descriptions of marks or growths lying on or outside an area.
modes.example: hard-to-see warts<< can>> be outside the area covered by the condom

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is 'surface' and lowers unrelated code-like tokens.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'surface', as in the surface of a planet or the Sun.
